title: Account Creation & Registration
description: Step-by-step guide to creating your Tijraa account and completing the registration process.
content:
Creating Your Tijraa Account

Getting started with Tijraa is simple. Follow these steps to create your account:

Step 1: Visit the Registration Page

Navigate to the Tijraa landing page and click the "Get Started" or "Register" button in the header.

Step 2: Fill in Your Information

You'll need to provide:

  • Your full name
  • Email address
  • Password (minimum 8 characters)
  • Confirm password

Step 3: Verify Your Email

After registration, check your email inbox for a verification link. Click the link to verify your email address.

Step 4: Complete Your Profile

Once verified, you'll be guided through a registration stepper where you can:

  • Add company information
  • Select your business type
  • Configure basic settings

Step 5: Choose a Subscription Plan

After completing your profile, you'll be redirected to the plans page where you can choose a subscription plan that fits your needs.

Next Steps

After creating your account, check out the Dashboard Overview guide to learn how to navigate your new Tijraa dashboard.
